title: Schedule appears as a top-level navigation item
permissions_required: Schedule: View (spec §14.1) - any role with Schedule access.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser (window at least 960px wide).
2. Your role has the Schedule: View permission.
steps: 1. Look at the app's main (top-level) navigation.
expected: 1. Schedule is listed as a top-level navigation item alongside Work Orders, Customers, Parts, and Reports.
2. Clicking it opens the Schedule screen.
